dataset_metadata.name: Timeseries data of a drive cycle aging test of 28 high energy NCA/C+Si round cells of type 18650
dataset_metadata.citation: Jöst, D.; Ringbeck, F.; Blömeke, A.; Sauer, D.U. (2021). Timeseries data of a drive cycle aging test of 28 high energy NCA/C+Si round cells of type 18650. DOI: 10.18154/RWTH-2021-02814

cell_info.cell_notes: Two cell batches: 20 cells starting 09/2018 (Cell 1-20), 8 cells starting 03/2019 (Cell 22-29). Cells bought in June 2018.

aging_modes.notes: All 28 cells aged at the same single condition. Cells were piecewise removed from the test for further examination.

time_protocol.notes: Two longer downtime phases due to equipment defects; cells stored at various SOCs at 25 °C during downtimes. After December 2020, some temperature measurements failed logging. Drive cycle repeated until 80% SOC discharged or voltage < 2.67 V with current < 1C. Average discharge power 4.85 W (~0.4 C at nominal voltage). CC charge at 1.02 A (0.3 C) to 4.05 V, CV cutoff at 0.068 A (0.02 C).

rawdata.data_quality_notes: Data corrected: false current readings between 4.2–4.8 A (set to 0) during drive cycle direction switching; voltage outliers outside 2.4–4.4 V set to NaN; current outliers >10.5 A set to NaN; temperature outliers outside 10–50 °C set to NaN.
rawdata.known_issues: Battery tester reproducibly produces false current reading between 4.2 A and 4.8 A instead of 0 A during direction switching. After December 2020, some temperature measurements failed logging.

checkup.notes: Checkup every 30 cycles: (1) capacity test with 0.3C discharge after CCCV full charge; (2) qOCV test with 0.1C charge and discharge; (3) pulse test with multiple currents at 3 SOCs (80%, 50%, 20%).

notes: Dataset published under DOI 10.18154/RWTH-2021-02814. Files follow the naming pattern Everlast_35E_0XX (one ZIP per cell, containing a CSV). CSV uses '.' for decimals and ',' as separator; timestamps in format yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS. Part of the EU Horizon 2020 EVERLASTING project (grant 713771). Temperature chamber: Binder MK 240.
